notes.title: Road To Version 1.0
notes.notes:
Bedroom Blackjack is nearly finished and version 1.0 is almost here. I have some good news and some bad news.

[b]Good News:[/b] I will release the completed game by 1 July 2024.
[b]Bad News:[/b] I have had to cut some non-essential features.

Originally I set out to make the best Strip Blackjack game EVER with 3D characters that are fully animated. I believe I have done that.

However, I have been making this game for a few years now using my spare time and my personal savings. In that time it has not sold very well and I have fewer than 1000 wishlists.

I have had to face the hard reality that this game won’t so much as break even and I have almost run out of my personal savings to fund it.

That being the case I have made the difficult decision to cut some non-essential features.

[h1]Cut Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Voice Acting
[*] Hard Difficulty
[/list]

[h1]Planned Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] New Stripping Animations - In Progress
[*] New Outfits - In Progress
[*] New Bedrooms
[*] Date Dialogue
[*] Complete Soundtrack
[*] Cloud Saves (Steam Only)
[/list]

[h1]Voice Acting - All Hope Is NOT Lost [/h1]
If game sales pick up after the release of version 1.0 I will revisit voice acting.

Until next time, player

notes.title: June 2022 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ihSZGxU.jpg[/img]

Welcome to June 2022!

Unfortunately I was not able to release a patch in May as intended due to some personal strife IRL.
However, progress is moving along quite well.

[h1]Shop[/h1]
I have almost completed the Shop that has been "Coming Soon" forever.

Despite rigorous planning I did not anticipate having to tear down the existing Inventory and Gift systems.
But I did it.  And it's GREAT!

The shop now shows items available for purchase as well as items you already have in your inventory.
One easy place that tells you what you have and what you "could" have.

I can easily make items available in this screen in future as the 3D artist delivers more outfits and as I introduce more gifts.
I have even built in support for Poses.  More on this later.

The final part I am working on is allowing you to select the purchased outfits from the game wizard.

[h1]Game Saves[/h1]
The changes to the Inventory system have broken the save files :(

I am working hard to preserve your existing save files so you do not lose any progress.

[h1]Voice Acting[/h1]
I have completed the system that can play voice clips through dialogue and in respond to game events e.g. Win, Lose, Push, etc.

I am currently working with voice actors to bring the various characters to life.
More on this soon.

[h1]Photo Mode[/h1]
As soon as the Shop is finished I will begin work on the Photo Mode.
This is the last big feature planned for Bedroom Blackjack.

That's right!  Bedroom Blackjack should officially be in BETA by July 2022!

[h1]Animation Assets[/h1]
Unfortunately, the animator I hired to make the remaining stripping animations has come on some hard times.
Regrettably they are unable to deliver any animations at all.

We are parting on good terms and I wish them all the best.

I will begin the hiring process for a new animator soon.

[h1]3D Art Outfits[/h1]
I am expecting 2 x new outfits very soon from the 3D artist that will be available in the Shop.
[list]
[*] Nurse Outfit
[*] Virgin Killer Sweater
[/list]

These are just a couple of the many outfits that have been designed greenlit for modelling.

[b]NOTE: The art in the screenshot is just placeholder art until the outfits are complete.[/b]

[h1]Release Delay[/h1]
Sadly I cannot send out a new patch until I resolve the game save issues and allow you to select the purchased outfits.

I am not sure when this might be available, but I am working every spare minute to make this happen ASAP.
Please be patient.

Until next time, player.

notes.title: March 2022 Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XqvRtW7.jpg[/img]

Welcome to March!

The original plan was to have bedroom Blackjack completed by now.
While the project has come a long way my development milestones have been slipping a little.

There have been some unanticipated delays and the game has increased in scope a little since it's launch.

Here is a complete update in the name of transparency.

[h1]Inventory System [/h1]
I have almost finished the new inventory system that will enable you to purchase outfits and gifts from the Shop.

[h1]Gifts[/h1]
I have had to rework much of how the playing deck works in order to support different types of cheats.
More gifts should become available soon.

[h1]Animation Assets[/h1]
I have hired an animator to make stripping animations for the remaining clothing items in the game.
The animator has encountered some delays, but I am assured that 8 x new stripping animations will be available this week.

[h1]3D Art Assets[/h1]
I had costumes planned for Valentines day and for the Mistress Of Cards, but the 3D artist has been unavailable lately.
I am working with them now to free up their availability and get those costumes into the game ASAP.

I am also looking into hiring a second 3D artist to increase the rate at which new costumes are added to the game.

[h1]Dialogue[/h1]
I had hoped to have all voice acting clips recorded and in the game by now.
However, I have not quite finished writing all of the dialogue yet.

This is because I need to consult a sensitivity professional as there are different backgrounds and cultures that I want to respect.
I want the game to have good representation and I recognise that I am not qualified to do that on my own.

[h1]Official Release Date[/h1]
I have made the decision to push back the official release of the complete game to September 2022.
This means that the game will have been have been in Early Access for 12 months.

Apologies for the inconvenience.

[h1]Thank You[/h1]
Thank you for your patience.  The community has been very supportive and patient with me. 

A special thank you to those who have given me valuable feedback about the game and given me opportunity to make Bedroom Blackjack better.

Until next time, player.

[*]Sound FX: Added clear Win/Lose sound effects to make it easier to determine of you won or lost
[*]User Interface: Added a save icon in the top right whenever a game is loaded
[*]Mechanics: Dealers no longer redress on PUSH
[*]Mechanics: Improved shuffling randomisation so the dealer does not win so often
[*]Mechanics: Reshuffle the deck each time the game mode is changed
[*]Settings: Added feature to save Audio preferences
[*]Settings: Added feature to save Graphics preferences
[*]NPCs: Modified characters so they are all slightly different heights.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game Save: Fixed some data that is lost for unlocked dealers sometimes
[*] Graphics: Enforced selection of supported screen resolutions to prevent UI bugs.
[/list]
